decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow objects to the proposal.

Condition : 2 - Informative.
The Council has identified that there is potential for noise and visual conflict between out-of-hours activity at the scout grounds and the proposed residential use.

Condition : 3 - Infomative.
There are concerns from the Third Osterley Sea Scout Group their grounds are a sensitive area catering for children's activities at various times of the day, and that there is potential for overlooking of the scout grounds from the development. Furthermore the organisation is concerned that the proposed development would overlook and overshadow any boat that is or may be moored in the River Crane.

Condition : 4 - Informative.
That should the London Borough of Richmond upon Thames be minded to approve the application, that the land required from the application site for the improvement of the Richmond Road traffic bridge, improvement of the Thames Path and necessary services be ceded for this purpose through a section 106 agreement. Richmond should liase with the Council's structures department to determine the exact dimensions of the required land.
description: Demolition of existing buildings, new development comprising of 18 residential units (9 Private dwellings  and 9 affordable flats) - (Other Borough Consultation)
